items.front: What is the BODMAS order, and how are ÷/× and +/− ranked?
items.back: Brackets → Orders (powers/roots) → Division & Multiplication (equal rank, left→right) → Addition & Subtraction (left→right).

items.front: How do you solve a defined-symbol problem, e.g. a△b = (a+b)÷(a−b)?
items.back: Substitute the rule exactly, then apply BODMAS. Respect operand order: a△b ≠ b△a. So 9△5 = 14÷4 = 3.5.

items.front: Give (a±b)², a²−b², and a²+b² in terms of (a+b) and ab.
Expand a³±b³ using (a±b) and ab; and x³±1/x³?
If x + 1/x = k, what is x² + 1/x²?
items.back: x² + 1/x² = k² − 2 (square and subtract the middle term 2). Likewise x² + 1/x² = (x−1/x)² + 2.

items.front: For ax²+bx+c=0: discriminant, nature of roots, sum and product?
items.back: D = b²−4ac: D>0 real distinct, D=0 real equal, D<0 imaginary. Sum of roots = −b/a; product = c/a.
items.examPoint: Quadratic equations — nature of roots & sum/product (discriminant)

items.front: AP: nth term and sum of n terms?
items.back: aₙ = a + (n−1)d; Sₙ = n/2 [2a + (n−1)d] = n/2 (first + last). Middle of three AP terms = their mean.

items.front: GP: finite sum and sum to infinity?
items.back: aₙ = a·r^{n-1}; Sₙ = a(r^{n}−1)/(r−1). S∞ = a/(1−r) valid ONLY when |r|<1 (else it diverges).

items.front: How is an HP solved? What is an AGP?
items.back: HP: take reciprocals → they form an AP → solve → invert back. AGP = arithmetic×geometric; sum via the S − rS shift method.

items.front: Remainder & Factor theorems for f(x) divided by (x−a)?
items.back: Remainder = f(a) (just substitute). (x−a) is a factor means f(a)=0. For divisor (ax−b) evaluate f(b/a).
n(A∪B) = n(A)+n(B)−n(A∩B); Neither = Universal − n(A∪B); Only A = n(A) − n(A∩B).
